title: Korean subcommittee does not conclude on revenue-based fine for financial firms over security failures; to be discussed again next month, Newspim reports
summary: Newspim reports the Political Affairs Committee’s first bill review subcommittee did not pass an amendment to the electronic financial transactions law that would raise fines for security failures to a share of revenue. Lawmakers of both parties disagreed on the fine criteria and exemption clauses. Newspim expects it to be discussed again next month.
plain: Newspim reports a Korean parliamentary subcommittee did not pass a bill to fine financial firms for security failures by a share of revenue; it is expected back next month.
exec: Newspim reports a bill to fine financial firms for security failures by a share of revenue was not passed and is expected back at the subcommittee next month.
